noProjectsHint: Connect GitLab/GitHub repositories so AI agents can handle tasks
noRegisteredProjects: No projects have been added yet.
addProjectFirst: Connect a project first to see and manage its tasks.
selectAProject: Select a project to see its tasks.
tokenHint: Required for task listing and completion reports. Stored encrypted.
baseBranchHint: The branch that work branches are forked from and that MR/PRs target. Leave empty to auto-detect the remote default.
baseBranchTestFirst: Run a connection test to fetch branches.
testSiteUrlHint: Open in a new tab via the globe button on the project card.
labelSystemHint: 5-stage flow — Inflow → Process → Verify → Confirm → Done. Each stage uses a (waiting / in-progress) label pair. Labels must exist in Git. Renaming a label on an existing project also renames it in the repository (attached issues keep it), and an installed AI guide gets an update MR with the new names.
labelsRenamed: Renamed {count} labels in the repository too
labelsRenamedGuide: Renamed {count} labels and opened an AI guide update MR
labelsRenamedGuideFail: Renamed {count} labels, but updating the AI guide failed: {error}
labelTargetDesc: Base label IVE tracks to enter the workflow. IVE removes it once a stage label is attached
stageProcessDesc: AI agent writes code and opens the merge request
stageVerifyDesc: Verifier reviews the code and decides whether it can be merged
stageConfirmDesc: Confirmer checks the merged change in the real environment
labelNotifyDesc: Only issues with this label send a Slack alert to the assignee on completion/failure
slackNotifyHint: When an issue has the notify label (set in Labels above) and the assignee has alerts on, a DM is sent on completion/failure. Set a channel below to also post there, mentioning the assignee.
slackNotifyChannelDesc: Leave empty to send DM only (no channel post). If you don't see ‘Copy channel ID’, right-click the channel in the sidebar → ‘Copy link’ and paste the URL here (the C… ID is extracted automatically). The bot must be invited to that channel.
aiGuideDescription: Install CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md in the repository so external AI CLIs (Claude Code, etc.) recognize "register to IVE" requests and follow the stage-label workflow for reviewing, confirming, and closing out work an agent has already done.
aiGuideMrMergeHint: You must merge this MR for the guide to take effect.
showToolUsageHint: Include tool calls like Read, Edit, Bash in agent execution logs
shareRoleHint: Viewer: View-only access / Editor: Can also create tasks
deleteProjectConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this project? All execution records will be removed.
leaveShareConfirm: Remove this shared project from your list? The owner's project will not be deleted; if the owner shares it again, it will reappear.
importFromProviderHint: Select a repository from your account and the name, URL, and token will be filled in automatically.
oauthAccountHint: The token for your {provider} account is managed automatically.
reportPageDesc: Generate a dedicated page where external users can easily submit tasks or report issues.
reportPageStep1: Share the generated URL on your test site, documentation, or email.
reportPageStep2: Users who access the link will see a form to submit tasks. An optional due date can be picked too — it maps directly to the GitLab/GitHub issue due date.
reportPageStep3: Submissions are automatically created as issues in this project with the to-do label (default ive:todo).
reportPageStep4: If the URL is leaked, click 'Regenerate URL' to immediately invalidate the old link.
reportPageThemeHint: Add ?theme=light&lang=en to the URL for a light theme in English. Default is dark theme in Korean.
reportPageApiHint: Submit programmatically without the UI. POST /api/report with projectId, secret, and content to create an issue. The optional dueDate (YYYY-MM-DD) sets a deadline.
reportPageSecurityHint: If the URL is leaked, use 'Regenerate URL' to invalidate the old link and generate a new one. Existing submissions are not affected.
reportPageCopyHint: Pick the theme and language for your audience first, then copy the URL.
reportPageEmbedDesc: Open this URL as-is (link, button, new window) to use the intake page. The token in the URL is single-use and expires in 7 days, so copy a fresh URL from here each time you share it.
reportPageApiDesc: Send content collected on another service's own form through the API. Copy the three values below into that service's settings. The caller signs a fresh token per submission with the secret, so there is no expiry or single-use limit.
reportPageApiSecretHint: The secret is the intake permission itself. If it leaks, use [Regenerate] below — every existing URL and integration stops working.
boardEmpty: No work has reached this stage yet.
boardSelect: Pick a project on the left

waitReason.assignee_mode: Assignee handles it — waiting for them to start in Git
waitReason.preferred_not_in_pool: Chosen agent unavailable — reassign a worker
waitReason.preferred_paused: Chosen agent on leave/paused — waiting for return
waitReason.preferred_busy: Chosen agent is busy with another task

stageFailHint: {n} failed in processing — waiting to be reprocessed
